.input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #111111;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

.input:focus {
    outline: none;
    background-color: #FEF3C7;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
}

.btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background-color: #111111;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #A78BFA;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.btn:hover {
    transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:active {
    transform: translate(2px, 2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px dashed #7C3AED;
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.btn-alt {
    color: #111111;
    background-color: #A7F3D0;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
}

.btn-alt:hover {
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #111111;
}

.actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 16px;
}

.result {
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 52px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 18px;
    background-color: #ECFCCB;
    border: 3px dashed #111111;
    border-radius: 12px;
}

.note {
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #4B5563;
}

.list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.list li {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #111111;
}

.check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.check input {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
}

    display: block;

}

}

JavaScript

function initApp() {
    var dayInput = document.getElementById('dayInput');
    var lookupBtn = document.getElementById('lookupBtn');
    var dayOut = document.getElementById('dayOut');
    var days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];

    lookupBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var n = parseFloat(dayInput.value);
        // TODO: If n is NaN, below 1, above 7 or not whole show "Enter 1 to 7";
        // otherwise show "Day " + n + " is " + days[n - 1].

    });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);
} else {
    initApp();
}

CSS

* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 24px 16px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.45;

    background-color: #FFF7ED;
}

    max-width: 480px;

    background-color: #FFFFFF;

    box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #111111;
}

.card-head {
    padding: 18px 20px 0;
}

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    background-color: #FDE68A;
    border: 2px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 999px;
}

.card h1 {
    margin: 8px 0 0;
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

    margin: 4px 0 0;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #4B5563;
}

.card-body {
    padding: 18px 20px 20px;
}

.field {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-end;
}

.row .field {
    flex: 1 1 120px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #111111;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

.input:focus {
    outline: none;
    background-color: #FEF3C7;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
}

.btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background-color: #111111;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #A78BFA;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.btn:hover {
    transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:active {
    transform: translate(2px, 2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px dashed #7C3AED;
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.btn-alt {
    color: #111111;
    background-color: #A7F3D0;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
}

.btn-alt:hover {
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #111111;
}

.actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 16px;
}

.result {
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 52px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 18px;
    background-color: #ECFCCB;
    border: 3px dashed #111111;
    border-radius: 12px;
}

.note {
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #4B5563;
}

.list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.list li {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #111111;
}

.check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.check input {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
}

/* ===== Emoji Inserter ===== */
.emoji-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.emoji-btn {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    /* TODO: Set font-size to 24px */
}

.emoji-btn:hover {
    background-color: #FDE68A;
}

.emoji-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px dashed #7C3AED;
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

function initApp() {
    var postText = document.getElementById('postText');
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.emoji-btn');

    function insertEmoji(emoji) {
        // TODO: Append emoji to the end of postText.value.

    }

    function makeHandler(button) {
        return function () {
            insertEmoji(button.textContent);
        };
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        buttons[i].addEventListener('click', makeHandler(buttons[i]));
    }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);
} else {
    initApp();
}

function initApp() {

    var restockBtn = document.getElementById('restockBtn');
    var ticketCount = document.getElementById('ticketCount');
    var ticketStatus = document.getElementById('ticketStatus');

        left = 5;
        ticketCount.textContent = left;
        ticketStatus.textContent = 'Available';
        buyBtn.disabled = false;
    });
}

function initApp() {
    var selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAll');
    var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.pack-box');
    var packCount = document.getElementById('packCount');

    function refreshCount() {
        var n = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < boxes.length; i++) {
            if (boxes[i].checked) {
                n = n + 1;
            }
        }
        packCount.textContent = n + ' of ' + boxes.length + ' packed';
    }

    for (var j = 0; j < boxes.length; j++) {
        boxes[j].addEventListener('change', refreshCount);
    }

    selectAll.addEventListener('change', function () {
        // TODO: Loop over boxes and set each .checked to selectAll.checked, then call refreshCount().

    });
}

}

.card h1 {
    margin: 8px 0 0;

}

}

}

    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-end;
}

.row .field {
    flex: 1 1 120px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;

.input:focus {

}

.btn {

.btn:hover {

.btn:active {

}

.btn-alt:hover {

}

.actions {
    display: flex;

}

.result {
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 52px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 18px;
    background-color: #ECFCCB;

}

.note {

    padding: 10px 12px;

}

.check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.check input {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
}

/* ===== Reading Checklist ===== */
.book-list input {
    accent-color: #7C3AED;
}

.progress-track {
    height: 22px;
    margin-top: 14px;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 999px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
    width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    /* TODO: Set background-color to #7C3AED */
}

JavaScript

function initApp() {
    var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.book');
    var progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
    var readCount = document.getElementById('readCount');

    function updateProgress() {
        // TODO: Count the checked boxes into n. progressFill.style.width = (n / boxes.length * 100) + "%";
        // readCount.textContent = n + " of " + boxes.length + " read".

    }

    for (var i = 0; i < boxes.length; i++) {
        boxes[i].addEventListener('change', updateProgress);
    }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);
} else {
    initApp();
}

function initApp() {
    var notes = document.getElementById('notes');
    var pinStatus = document.getElementById('pinStatus');
    var buttons = notes.querySelectorAll('.pin-btn');

    function pinNote(card) {
        // TODO: notes.insertBefore(card, notes.firstChild);
        // pinStatus.textContent = "Pinned: " + card.querySelector(".note-title").textContent.

    }

    function makeHandler(button) {
        return function () {
            pinNote(button.parentNode);
        };
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        buttons[i].addEventListener('click', makeHandler(buttons[i]));
    }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);
} else {
    initApp();
}

        // favCount.textContent = n === 1 ? "1 favorite" : n + " favorites".

    }

    function makeHandler(button) {
        return function () {
            addFavorite(button.parentNode, button);
        };

}

    padding: 12px 18px;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background-color: #111111;
    border: 3px solid #111111;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #A78BFA;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.btn:hover {
    transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:active {
    transform: translate(2px, 2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 #A78BFA;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px dashed #7C3AED;
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.btn-alt {
    color: #111111;
    background-color: #A7F3D0;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
}

.btn-alt:hover {
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #111111;
}

.actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 16px;
}

.result {
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 52px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 18px;
    background-color: #ECFCCB;
    border: 3px dashed #111111;
    border-radius: 12px;
}

.note {
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #4B5563;
}

.list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.list li {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #111111;
}

.check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.check input {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
}

/* ===== Language Toggle ===== */
.greet {
    margin: 0 0 6px;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.copy {
    margin: 0 0 14px;
    color: #4B5563;
}

.lang-btn {
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    color: #111111;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111111;
    /* TODO: Set border-style to dashed */
}

        <div class="card-head">
            <span class="badge">Food</span>
            <h1>Toppings Total</h1>
            <p class="tagline">Base price plus every topping you tick.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <div class="toppings">
                <label class="check topping"><input class="topping-box" type="checkbox" data-price="1.50"> Mushrooms — $1.50</label>
                <label class="check topping"><input class="topping-box" type="checkbox" data-price="1.00"> Olives — $1.00</label>
                <label class="check topping"><input class="topping-box" type="checkbox" data-price="2.25"> Bacon — $2.25</label>
            </div>

* {
